description: Deliberately small keyed-retrieval benchmark input for the benchmark-author golden path. Each query names exactly one gold record; sibling records share vocabulary so ranking, not mere presence, is exercised.

records.text: The cobalt ledger reconciles invoice totals for the finance team every Friday.
The amber ledger reconciles payroll totals for the finance team every Monday.
The cedar queue dispatches field technicians to outage tickets in the north region.
The ivory queue dispatches warehouse pickers to restock tickets in the south region.
The onyx cache keeps session tokens for the mobile client for twelve hours.
The jade cache keeps rendered thumbnails for the web client for thirty days.
The slate vault stores signing keys for release builds behind hardware attestation.
The coral vault stores backup credentials for the archive cluster behind a two-person rule.
Weather observations for the rooftop sensor are logged every ten minutes.
The cafeteria menu rotates weekly and is posted on the intranet.

queries.query: Which ledger reconciles invoice totals for finance?
Which ledger reconciles payroll totals on Monday?
Which queue dispatches technicians to outage tickets?
Which queue dispatches warehouse pickers for restock tickets?
Which cache keeps session tokens for the mobile client?
Which cache keeps rendered thumbnails for the web client?
Which vault stores signing keys for release builds?
Which vault stores backup credentials for the archive cluster?

metrics.exact_top1: fraction of queries whose rank-1 recalled id equals gold_id
metrics.recall_at_3: fraction of queries whose gold_id appears within the first three recalled ids
